detector.name: K8S Cluster Deployment is not at spec
detector.programText:
A = data('k8s.deployment.desired').sum(by=['k8s.namespace.name', 'k8s.cluster.name', 'deployment']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('k8s.deployment.available').sum(by=['k8s.namespace.name', 'k8s.cluster.name', 'deployment']).publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (B-A).publish(label='C')
detect((when((C > threshold(0)) or (C < threshold(0)), lasting='5m', at_least=0.8))).publish('K8S Cluster Deployment is not at spec')
